record.paper_title: On two long standing open problems on Lp-spaces
record.original_question: Is every complemented infinite-dimensional subspace of L1 isomorphic either to L1 itself or to the sequence space ell1? Here a complemented subspace of L1 is a closed subspace that is the range of a bounded projection on L1, and isomorphic means isomorphic as a Banach space.

evidence.quote: Problem 1 (Lindenstrauss and Rosenthal, 1969, [29]). Is every complemented infinite dimensional subspace of L1 isomorphic to either L1 or ell1?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $L_1 = L_1[0,1]$ denote the Banach space of (equivalence classes of) Lebesgue-integrable real-valued functions on $[0,1]$ with the norm $\|f\|_1 = \int_0^1 |f(t)|\,dt$, and let $\ell_1$ denote the Banach space of absolutely summable real sequences with the norm $\|(a_n)\|_1 = \sum_{n=1}^\infty |a_n|$. A closed subspace $X \subseteq L_1$ is called complemented if there exists a bounded linear projection $P: L_1 \to L_1$ with range $X$. Two Banach spaces are said to be isomorphic if there exists a bounded linear bijection between them whose inverse is also bounded.

Question: Is it true that every infinite-dimensional complemented closed subspace of $L_1$ is isomorphic (as a Banach space) either to $L_1$ or to $\ell_1$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question, due to Lindenstrauss and Rosenthal (1969), remains a well-known long-standing open problem. Recent surveys and papers (2023–2025) on complemented subspaces of Banach lattices continue to list it as open, while related variants (e.g., for C(K)-spaces) have been settled by Plebanek and Salguero-Alarcón.

status_evidence.title: Complemented subspaces of Banach lattices (de Hevia, Tradacete)
status_evidence.snippet: The complemented subspace problem for L1, asking whether every complemented subspace of L1[0,1] is isomorphic to ℓ1 or L1[0,1], remains open.
status_evidence.claim: Recent (2025) work identifies the L1 complemented subspace problem as still open.

status_evidence.title: A Survey on the Complemented Subspace Problem
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of the complemented subspace problem listing the L1 case as a long-standing open question.
status_evidence.claim: Survey confirms the open status of the problem.
